reviewNotes: Reviewed all 39 inputs for financial meaning, hiragana readings, long vowels and doubled consonants. User samples retain display text; particles are corrected only in speech input. Checked contextual topic は→わ and object を→お; no directional へ occurs. Retain lexical は in はらった/はたらいて, lexical わ in くらべる and よゆう, and long vowels in きゅうりょう/しゅうにゅう/こうねつひ/へいきんねんしゅう. 日本 uses the supplied にほん, not にっぽん. 金融手取り uses てどり. Commas occur after complete phrases/clauses and never immediately before a particle. Natural Tokyo intonation is authorized for unconfirmed phrase/compound pitch; component targets do not certify a whole expression. No audible pitch or listening verification is claimed. Topic and section titles have no recordings.
